notes.title: Update Notes April 6th 2022
notes.notes:
Fix for Korean version:
-Added additional voices which are missing in Korean version only.

notes.title: Update Notes for August 22, 2021
notes.notes:
- Fixed the issue where the previous chapter parameters won't be saved correctly in a save data if players has started another route. This fix might affect your previous save data load point, and will only affect the new save data which has been made since the fix is applied. You can also choose to play from chapter select screen to get this fix applied.
- Changed some term to fit the context better.

notes.title: 2020 July Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi.
I noticed that there's some issue with lags or freeze within the beginning of the game or when the CG appears. These issue, is actually because of an ownership verification code, which takes longer than usual since a new SSL update on my site is implemented.
I made a patch to settle these issue that will be applied on the newest build automatically.
What will be affected is the English and French version only, as the other languages version doesn't have that feature.
Please let me know if you get any further issues.

Cheers,
Chu-3/Roseverte

notes.title: French Version Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Today a bug fix patch has been released for the French version of HTFALK.
Platform: MAC and Windows
Fixed bugs:
-Some chapters name are still in English, and caused a wrong chapter name save data. 
The fix will fix the chapter name, and will not change anything inside the save data itself.
Player can continue playing as normal.

notes.title: Urgent announcement about Mac OSx Catalina Update
notes.notes:
Today I got an email which mentioned that people who has played the game with the non notarized version got a trouble to play the notarized version, so I decided to reverted all the apps which I has updated to support Catalina to the previous version while I'll try to find out the solution. 

Only East Tower series are still at 32 bit which won't work with Catalina, so I will build a non notarized 64 bit version first to settle the issue first.
I already tested but the non notarized 64 bit version apps are still working fine with Catalina, so that should be fine for the temporary solution.

Beside this, I also noticed the earlier build of CAFE 0 Mermaid achievements are not triggered on Mac. This will also get my priority too. Hopefully I can update everything until tomorrow.
I'm very sorry for the inconvenience.

Sincerely,
Chu-3/Roseverte

notes.title: DLCs Update! Added 16 bit and 24 bit FLAC Lossless!
notes.notes:
Both of the Theme Song and Insert Song are now updated with the lossless FLAC version. Both of the 16 bit and 24 bit version are included in each dlc folders.

For people in bad/slow internet area, please be careful since the file size becomes super huge with this update. The previous dlc was around 20MBs ish per dlc, but now it's around 300MB, as one song can be more than 60 MB.

Enjoy! :regina:
